text: In this experiment, you will investigate the oscillations of a magnet.
You have been provided with a small magnet attached to a string. You have also been provided
with a bar magnet, a plotting compass and a sheet of paper.

text: In this experiment, you will investigate the behaviour of suspended cardboard sheets.
You have been provided with two cardboard sheets labelled A and B.
